sloka: दृष्ट्वैव विललापार्त्तो बाष्पसन्दिग्धया गिरा।अशक्नुवन् धारयितुं धैर्याद्वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ २.९९.३०॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvaiva vilalāpārtto bāṣpasandigdhayā girā।aśaknuvan dhārayituṁ dhairyādvacanamabravīt ॥ 2.99.30॥

translations.english: On seeing Rama, Bharata could not control his grief with patience and lamented in great anguish and with words choked with tears said:
